The '''Akuria system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Oplovis sector/Legends|Oplovis sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Akuria II]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Akurian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].
